digest.component_or_area: PydanticAIRunner lifecycle (runner.py, providers.py, agent_call.py, model_classes.py, structured_run.py, runner_support.py)
propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() already has correct single ownership for every effect/resource boundary (tracing, provider session, model fallback scope, capability checks, failure accounting, answer attribution, finalization) across its 388-line orchestration sequence, per ADR 0056/0058 decomposition.

A raise during finalize_outcome (post-ProviderSession, post-exception-handler) skips spend recording and failure logging, creating a narrow billing-accuracy gap where real tokens are burned but not recorded—characterized as current observed behavior, not a design flaw in current ownership.

No restructuring of run()'s ownership is warranted: extracting the sequencing logic itself would require the generic lifecycle framework/hook-plugin bus this ticket forbids, and provenance/settings mutation patterns are already handled correctly by their existing owners.
All monkeypatch targets and string imports in runner.py are already documented re-exports; semantic and text/string consumer censuses agree with no undiscovered compatibility hazards.
The finalize_outcome-raise spend-row gap is a real but out-of-scope billing concern, suitable for a discovered_from-linked follow-up ticket rather than scope expansion of this revalidation research.
